title: WaterHouse 304- Open Air | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Amazing location! Sitting on 30A offering a dedicated beach and a unit with beautiful decor. Boasting a stunning rooftop pool, panoramic views, workout room, sauna, on-site sundries snack bar and pub!
description_expanded: Description: WaterHouse 304- Open Air by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 8377 E County Highway 30A, Unit 304 Details: Welcome to WaterHouse 304-Open Air, a beautifully updated 3BR/3BA condo located directly on Scenic 30A in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Just 200 feet from private, gated beach access, this third-floor retreat offers stunning Gulf views and an effortless coastal vibe. Recently renovated inside and out, this home features new décor, lighting, and furnishings, a custom 16-ft quartz kitchen island, and Viking stainless steel appliances. Enjoy movie nights on the 86” Smart TV, with additional 55” Smart TVs in every bedroom. Sleeping up to 10 guests, the condo includes a king suite with jetted tub, queen suite, bunk/queen room, and a bonus sleeper sofa. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors open to a spacious balcony, perfect for coffee at sunrise or dinner with a view. With its elegant design, thoughtful upgrades, and proximity to the beach, Open Air at WaterHouse is your next unforgettable 30A getaway. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 100 Feet (1 Minute Walk) -Rooftop Pool with Stunning Panoramic Views -Parking Spaces: 2 Spaces in Lot -Dining Accommodations: 8 Indoor Dining / 6 Island Bar Seating / 8 Outdoor Dining -Coffee Maker Available -Community Grill Available on the Rooftop -Outdoor Shower -Waterhouse Provisions + Bottleshop (located on 1st floor of building) Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 8 3 Bedrooms / 3 Bathrooms Main Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 2: Queen Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: Queen Bed and Built-In Bunk Bed (Twin/Twin) Shared Bath (Tub/Shower Combo) -Queen Sleeper Sofa in Living Area -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Laundry Room Amenities Include: -2 Adult Bikes Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
